title: List of references on Sony websites to players "owning" their digital games
why_read: A documented catalog of contradictory marketing language around digital game ownership is useful ammunition in the ongoing digital-rights debate but not deeply technical.
analysis: This is a compiled list of instances where Sony's own marketing or store language referred to purchased digital games as being 'owned' by players, despite licensing terms that say otherwise. It's relevant to the broader consumer-rights and DRM debate rather than being a technical deep-dive, useful mainly as evidence in policy or legal arguments. Engineers interested in digital rights management, consumer law, or platform economics may find it a handy reference. It's more of a research/advocacy artifact than new technical work.
